title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder - 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, featuring a weighted base to help prevent tipping and a felt pad to help protect surfaces.

  • Freestanding design: requires no wall mounting for flexible placement
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Weighted base: helps prevent tipping during everyday use
  • Felt pad: helps prevent scratching on most surfaces
  • Finish options: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs

  • Category: Paper Towel Holders
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions: 5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included: Paper towel holder
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Contemporary Counter Top Kitchen Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Complete your kitchen décor with this finely crafted counter top paper towel holder. Keep your counter top clutter free while adding the finishing touch to your space. Made of solid brass and provided with a lifetime finish to insure products will never rust.
